headline: COP31: Failure Sparks Criticism and Calls for Reform of Climate Negotiations
summary: After two weeks of talks, COP31 approved only technical texts and not the political declaration intended to conclude the summit. The outcome has prompted criticism and calls to reform climate negotiations.
why: UN climate summits set the framework for national emissions policies, which influence energy investment, carbon pricing and transition-related sectors.
original_headline: COP31: Fracaso desata críticas y reclamos de reforma de las negociaciones climáticas
